## CVE-2026-109469

CVE-2026-109469 is an authorization bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Device Registration caused by an improperly validated user-controlled key. This vulnerability allows an unauthorized remote attacker to escalate privileges within the network environment.

Affected products:
- Entra Device Registration

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-109469

## CVE-2026-109454

Microsoft Office SharePoint contains a vulnerability involving improper neutralization of input during web page generation, specifically categorized as cross-site scripting (XSS). This flaw allows an authorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network, potentially leading to unauthorized interaction or data manipulation within the application context.

Affected products:
- Office SharePoint

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-109454

Affected products:
- Azure DevOps

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-109467

## CVE-2026-112967

Affected products:
- Xbox Live Networking Service

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-112967

- Azure Managed Grafana

- Windows Virtual Filtering Platform

## CVE-2026-100204

Affected products:
- HEIF Image Extensions

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-100204

## CVE-2026-100223

CVE-2026-100223 describes an elevation of privilege vulnerability in Windows where sandboxed processes can create reparse points to perform a sandbox escape. By exploiting this, a local attacker can elevate privileges on the host system. The patch restricts the ability of sandboxed processes to create reparse points targeting files that would otherwise be inaccessible.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-100223

## CVE-2026-102219

CVE-2026-102219 describes a vulnerability in Windows Modern Device Management (MDM) arising from inadequate encryption strength. This flaw enables an unauthorized remote attacker to execute arbitrary code within the context of the MDM service over the network.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-102219

## CVE-2026-102224

- Azure CycleCloud

## CVE-2026-102230

CVE-2026-102230 describes a missing authorization vulnerability in Visual Studio Code that permits an unauthorized attacker to perform information disclosure over a network. The vulnerability poses a significant risk to the confidentiality of data accessible within the VS Code environment.

- Visual Studio Code

- Windows

- Windows

- Windows

## CVE-2026-105511

CVE-2026-105511 describes a race condition vulnerability in the Windows Point-to-Point Protocol over Ethernet (PPPoE) driver. An authorized local attacker can exploit this improper synchronization flaw to escalate privileges on a target Windows system.

Affected products:
- Windows Point-to-Point Protocol over Ethernet (PPPoE)

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105511

## CVE-2026-105512

An integer underflow vulnerability exists in Microsoft QUIC, which can be triggered by an unauthorized attacker to cause a denial-of-service condition over a network, potentially impacting availability of services utilizing the protocol implementation.

Affected products:
- Microsoft QUIC

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105512

## CVE-2026-105513

CVE-2026-105513 is an elevation of privilege vulnerability in the Windows Kernel caused by improper memory object handling. A local, authenticated attacker can exploit this flaw by executing a specially crafted application to gain elevated permissions on the host system.

Affected products:
- Windows Kernel

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105513

## CVE-2026-105524

A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) due to weak authentication mechanisms. The vulnerability allows an attacker who already has local authorized access to the system to escalate their privileges.

Affected products:
- Windows Management Instrumentation

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105524

## CVE-2026-105525

CVE-2026-105525 describes an integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability in the Windows Network Connection Broker component. This flaw allows an authenticated local attacker to achieve privilege escalation on the affected system.

Affected products:
- Windows Network Connection Broker

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105525

## CVE-2026-105526

CVE-2026-105526 describes a double-free vulnerability within the Windows Sockets (Winsock) component. An authorized attacker with local access can exploit this flaw to achieve privilege escalation on the affected Windows system.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105526

## CVE-2026-105528

CVE-2026-105528 describes a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Desktop Window Manager (DWM) component on Windows systems. The vulnerability allows an authenticated local attacker to execute arbitrary code or otherwise manipulate system memory to achieve privilege escalation.

Affected products:

CVE-2026-105543 describes a null pointer dereference vulnerability within the Windows Installer service. An authorized local attacker can exploit this flaw to escalate privileges on the affected system.

- Windows Installer

## CVE-2026-105544

CVE-2026-105544 describes an improper access control vulnerability within the .NET framework that enables an authorized local attacker to perform a privilege escalation attack. This flaw allows a user with restricted access to gain higher-level permissions on the host system.

Affected products:
- .NET

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105544

## CVE-2026-105545

CVE-2026-105545 describes an elevation of privilege vulnerability in the Windows Installer service caused by improper input sanitization. This flaw allows a locally authenticated attacker to trigger insecure library loading, resulting in the execution of arbitrary code with system-level privileges.

Affected products:
- Windows Installer

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105545

## CVE-2026-105546

A race condition vulnerability exists in Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) that allows an authorized local attacker to elevate privileges. The flaw arises from improper synchronization during concurrent resource execution, potentially allowing a user with low-level permissions to gain higher-level system access.

Affected products:
- Windows Management Instrumentation

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105546

## CVE-2026-105547

A double free vulnerability exists in the Windows Setup and Deployment component, which can be leveraged by an authorized local attacker to achieve privilege escalation.

Affected products:
- Windows Setup and Deployment

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105547

## CVE-2026-105551

CVE-2026-105551 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability residing in the Windows NetBIOS component. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this flaw to achieve privilege escalation over the network.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105551

## CVE-2026-105553

A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), which could allow an already authorized user to escalate their privileges locally on the affected system.

Affected products:
- Windows Filtering Platform

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105553

## CVE-2026-105554

A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the Windows Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS), which can be leveraged by a locally authenticated user to escalate privileges on the affected Windows system.

Affected products:
- Background Intelligent Transfer Service

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105554

## CVE-2026-105558

CVE-2026-105558 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Windows Deployment Services. An authorized attacker on the network can leverage this flaw to execute arbitrary code. Detection engineers should monitor WDS traffic and service behavior for anomalous memory access patterns consistent with buffer overflow exploitation.

Affected products:
- Windows Deployment Services

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105558

## CVE-2026-105560

CVE-2026-105560 is a vulnerability in the Windows DHCP Server component involving the release of an invalid pointer or reference. This vulnerability allows an authorized attacker to achieve remote code execution over a network.

Affected products:
- Windows DHCP Server

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105560

## CVE-2026-105561

A vulnerability exists in the Windows Secure Socket Tunneling Protocol (SSTP) that allows an unauthorized, remote attacker to trigger uncontrolled resource consumption. This condition leads to a denial of service (DoS) state, potentially impacting the availability of the affected Windows systems.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105561

## CVE-2026-105565

CVE-2026-105565 is a use-after-free vulnerability located in the Windows MIDI Service Module. Successful exploitation of this flaw allows an authorized local attacker to elevate their privileges on the host system.

Affected products:
- Windows MIDI Service Module

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105565

## CVE-2026-105566

A race condition vulnerability exists in the Windows Kernel that allows a locally authenticated attacker to elevate their privileges by exploiting improper synchronization during concurrent resource access.

Affected products:

## CVE-2026-105583

The Windows DWM (Desktop Window Manager) Core Library contains an elevation of privilege vulnerability stemming from the release of an invalid pointer or reference. A local attacker with authorization can exploit this flaw to gain elevated privileges on the system.

Affected products:
- Windows

- Windows

CVE-2026-105590 is a security feature bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Windows Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS). The vulnerability stems from improper certificate validation, which can be exploited by an authorized attacker over a network to bypass security controls associated with certificate issuance or validation processes.

Affected products:
- Active Directory Certificate Services

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-105590

- ODBC Driver

## CVE-2026-62903

CVE-2026-62903 describes an authentication bypass vulnerability within Microsoft.Data.SqlClient caused by a capture-replay flaw in SQL Server. An attacker capable of intercepting network traffic can perform a replay attack to bypass authentication mechanisms, potentially leading to unauthorized information disclosure.

Affected products:
- Microsoft.Data.SqlClient

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-62903

## CVE-2026-85838

A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the Microsoft WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL, which can be leveraged by an unauthorized remote attacker to achieve arbitrary code execution over a network.

Affected products:
- WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85838

## CVE-2026-85839

Microsoft has disclosed a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL. The vulnerability allows an unauthorized attacker to achieve remote code execution over a network. Detection engineers should monitor for abnormal activity involving OLE DB data provider calls or unexpected memory growth within processes interacting with SQL data services.

Affected products:
- WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-85839

- Azure CLI

## CVE-2026-70240

- Windows

- Windows

## CVE-2026-95961

CVE-2026-95961 is a privilege escalation vulnerability in the Windows USB Video Driver caused by a double free condition. An attacker with local access and authorization can exploit this flaw to execute code or gain higher privileges within the system context.

Affected products:
- Windows USB Video Driver

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-95961

## CVE-2026-95963

CVE-2026-95963 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in the Data Sharing Service Client caused by improper link resolution before file access (link following). An authorized local attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain elevated privileges on the system.

Affected products:
- Data Sharing Service Client

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-95963

## CVE-2026-95964

CVE-2026-95964 describes a race condition vulnerability in the Microsoft Remote Desktop Client, arising from improper synchronization during concurrent execution with shared resources. This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthorized attacker to achieve arbitrary code execution over a network.

Affected products:
- Remote Desktop Client

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-95964

Affected products:
- Windows

- Windows Performance Counters

Affected products:
- Windows Event Viewer

## CVE-2026-95998

CVE-2026-95998 is an authentication bypass vulnerability within the Windows StateRepository API. An attacker with authorized local access can leverage this flaw to perform unauthorized tampering with system state data, potentially leading to privilege escalation.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-95998

## CVE-2026-96077

A null pointer dereference vulnerability exists within the Windows TCP/IP stack, which can be leveraged by an unauthorized remote attacker to cause a denial of service condition by sending specifically crafted network traffic.

## CVE-2026-96078

A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in Microsoft Color Management that enables a remote, unauthorized attacker to execute arbitrary code. The vulnerability allows for RCE via network-accessible vectors, necessitating prompt patching of affected systems.

Affected products:
- Microsoft Color Management

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-96078

## CVE-2026-96081

A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the Windows Rich Text Edit Control, which could be leveraged by a remote, unauthorized attacker to execute arbitrary code on the target system.

Affected products:
- Windows Rich Text Edit Control

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-96081

## CVE-2026-96082

CVE-2026-96082 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Kerberos service that allows an authorized attacker to trigger a denial of service condition over the network.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-96082

## CVE-2026-96993

CVE-2026-96993 is a remote code execution vulnerability in Windows Performance Monitor caused by an invalid pointer or reference release. An unauthorized attacker can exploit this over the network to achieve code execution on a vulnerable system.

Affected products:
- Windows Performance Monitor

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-96993

- Windows

- Windows PCI Bus Driver

- Windows

## CVE-2026-88224

An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists in the Windows AppX Deployment Service due to improper link resolution before file access. An attacker with authorized local access can exploit this vulnerability to escalate their privileges on the target system.

Affected products:
- Windows AppX Deployment Service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-88224

## CVE-2026-88229

CVE-2026-88229 describes a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Windows Media Player that can be leveraged by an unauthorized remote attacker to achieve arbitrary code execution via network-based vectors.

Affected products:
- Windows Media Player

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-88229

## CVE-2026-88234

CVE-2026-88234 describes a remote code execution vulnerability in the Windows iSCSI implementation, caused by the release of an invalid pointer or reference. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code over the network, likely due to a memory management issue within the iSCSI service.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-88234

## CVE-2026-88237

CVE-2026-88237 is a use-after-free vulnerability within the Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL). An attacker who has already achieved an authorized user context on the host system can exploit this flaw to execute code or perform operations with elevated privileges.

Affected products:
- Windows Subsystem for Linux

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-88237

## CVE-2026-88238

A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Camera Frame Server Monitor allows a local, authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability is classified as a privilege escalation issue within the camera server subsystem.

Affected products:
- Windows Camera Frame Server Monitor

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-88238

Affected products:
- Windows Biometric Service

## CVE-2026-88240

CVE-2026-88240 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows DHCP Client that allows an authorized attacker on an adjacent network to elevate their privileges. Detection efforts should focus on anomalous behavior related to the DHCP client service and attempts to leverage memory corruption vulnerabilities for privilege escalation.

Affected products:
- Windows DHCP Client

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-88240

## CVE-2026-88242

A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock (afdsys) that allows an authenticated local attacker to escalate privileges to the level of the kernel or SYSTEM. The vulnerability requires the attacker to have basic access to the system prior to execution.

Affected products:
- Windows

## CVE-2026-88245

CVE-2026-88245 describes a local privilege escalation vulnerability in the Windows Brokering File System due to missing authentication for a critical function. An attacker with authorized access can exploit this flaw to elevate their privileges on the host system.

Affected products:
- Windows

## CVE-2026-95976

A race condition vulnerability in the Windows Diagnostic Policy Service allows a locally authenticated attacker to escalate privileges. The vulnerability is caused by concurrent execution using a shared resource with improper synchronization.

Affected products:
- Windows Diagnostic Policy Service

## CVE-2026-95983

CVE-2026-95983 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in the Windows Graphics Kernel caused by an untrusted pointer dereference. Successful exploitation allows an authorized, authenticated user to gain higher privileges on the target system.

Affected products:
- Windows

## CVE-2026-96153

A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Windows Error Reporting (WER) allows a locally authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges to a higher integrity level on affected Windows systems.

## CVE-2026-96989

CVE-2026-96989 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Secondary Logon service, which could allow a local, authenticated attacker to disclose sensitive information. Detection efforts should focus on unauthorized or suspicious interaction with the Secondary Logon service and anomalous memory access patterns associated with the local authentication process.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-96989

## CVE-2026-97000

A null pointer dereference vulnerability exists within the Windows USM Communication Manager that can be exploited by an authorized local attacker to achieve privilege escalation.

Affected products:
- Windows USM Communication Manager

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-97000

## CVE-2026-96979

CVE-2026-96979 describes an integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability within the Windows HID Parser Library. This flaw allows an unauthorized attacker with physical access to the target system to achieve local privilege escalation. Defenders should focus on monitoring for unauthorized hardware connectivity or kernel-level modifications related to HID device parsing.

## CVE-2026-112761

A use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Broadcast DVR User Service allows a locally authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. Successful exploitation requires the attacker to be already authorized on the system.

Affected products:
- Windows Broadcast DVR User Service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-112761

## CVE-2026-112762

CVE-2026-112762 is a privilege escalation vulnerability in the Windows Print Spooler components caused by a relative path traversal issue. The vulnerability allows an unauthorized attacker to gain elevated privileges over a network, potentially leading to full system compromise.

Affected products:
- Windows Print Spooler

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-112762

Affected products:
- Windows

## CVE-2026-112803

A vulnerability in the Windows Cloud Files Mini Filter Driver allows an authorized local attacker to bypass access controls and disclose sensitive information. This issue stems from improper access control handling within the driver, potentially enabling unauthorized access to protected local data.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-112803

## CVE-2026-112805

CVE-2026-112805 is an elevation of privilege vulnerability in the Windows Kernel caused by an untrusted pointer dereference. An attacker must have local access and be authorized to execute code on the system to exploit this vulnerability, which allows them to gain higher privileges than their current account permits.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-112805

## CVE-2026-112807

CVE-2026-112807 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Microsoft Local Security Authority Server (lsasrv) component of LSASS. An authorized attacker can trigger this vulnerability over the network to cause a denial of service condition in the LSASS process.

## CVE-2026-113755

A use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Filter Manager allows a local, authorized attacker to escalate their privileges. This flaw resides within the kernel-mode driver responsible for managing file system filter drivers.

Affected products:
- Windows Filter Manager

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-113755





































































































































Related in this roundup: [CVE-2026-121673](#cve-2026-121673).

## CVE-2026-113756

CVE-2026-113756 describes an improper access control vulnerability in the Windows FileCrypt Driver that enables an authenticated attacker to perform a security feature bypass over the network. Security teams should monitor for unauthorized access attempts or suspicious network-based interactions involving the FileCrypt component.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-113756

## CVE-2026-113758

CVE-2026-113758 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Desktop Window Manager (DWM). An attacker who has already achieved initial access and local authorization can exploit this flaw to elevate their privileges on the host system.

Affected products:
- Desktop Window Manager

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-113758

## CVE-2026-113760

A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the Windows XWizard Framework, which allows a locally authenticated attacker to elevate their privileges to a higher integrity level on affected Windows systems.

Affected products:
- Windows XWizard Framework

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-113760

## CVE-2026-113761

An untrusted pointer dereference vulnerability in the Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver (unionfs.sys) allows a locally authenticated attacker to escalate privileges. Successful exploitation requires the attacker to be authorized to execute code on the system.

Affected products:
- Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-113761































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































Related in this roundup: [CVE-2026-113771](#cve-2026-113771).

## CVE-2026-113762

A use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Broadcast DVR User Service could allow an authorized local attacker to achieve privilege escalation.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-113762

## CVE-2026-113764

CVE-2026-113764 is an information disclosure vulnerability in the Windows Projected File System caused by a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition. An authorized local attacker can exploit this flaw to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information.

Affected products:
- Windows Projected File System

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-113764

- Windows Language Experience Service

- Windows

## CVE-2026-113819

CVE-2026-113819 is a use-after-free vulnerability within the Windows Desktop Window Manager (DWM) component. The flaw allows a locally authenticated attacker to escalate privileges on the affected system by triggering the memory corruption state.

Affected products:
- Desktop Window Manager

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-113819

## CVE-2026-113825

CVE-2026-113825 is a remote code execution vulnerability in the Windows SMB Server Network Transport Driver (srvnet.sys). The flaw stems from a race condition due to improper synchronization during concurrent execution with shared resources, potentially allowing an authorized network attacker to achieve code execution.

Affected products:
- Windows SMB Server

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-113825

## CVE-2026-105562

The Windows Container Manager Service contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition that can be exploited by an authorized attacker to achieve local information disclosure. This vulnerability requires the attacker to already have a level of access to the system to initiate the race condition.

Affected products:
- Windows Container Manager Service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-105562

## CVE-2026-105568

CVE-2026-105568 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services that allows an authorized attacker to trigger a denial of service condition over the network.

Affected products:
- Active Directory Domain Services

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-105568

## CVE-2026-108401

CVE-2026-108401 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Windows Remote Desktop Services that allows an authorized attacker to achieve remote code execution over a network.

Affected products:
- Remote Desktop Services

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-108401

## CVE-2026-113842

CVE-2026-113842 describes a use-after-free vulnerability within the Windows Security Center service that permits a local, authorized attacker to escalate their privileges on the host system.

Affected products:
- Windows Security Center

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-113842

## CVE-2026-113843

CVE-2026-113843 is an elevation of privilege vulnerability in the Windows Remote Access Connection Manager component caused by improper authentication. The flaw allows an authenticated local attacker to execute operations with higher privileges than their account is entitled to.

Affected products:
- Windows Remote Access Connection Manager

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-113843

## CVE-2026-113844

A local privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Windows NTFS due to improper access control, which may allow an authorized attacker to perform unauthorized file system tampering.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-113844

Affected products:
- Windows NTFS

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-113848

Affected products:
- Windows Encrypting File System

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-105527

## CVE-2026-105530

CVE-2026-105530 is a use-after-free vulnerability within the Windows System Events Broker component. An authorized, local attacker can leverage this flaw to perform unauthorized information disclosure on the target system.

Affected products:
- Windows System Events Broker

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-105530

## CVE-2026-105531

A vulnerability in the Windows Print Spooler components allows an authorized local attacker to exploit external control over file paths, leading to the unauthorized disclosure of information.

Affected products:
- Windows Print Spooler

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-105531

## CVE-2026-105537

CVE-2026-105537 describes an information disclosure vulnerability in the Windows Mailslot File System caused by the use of an uninitialized resource. An authorized local attacker can exploit this flaw to read sensitive data from the system.

Affected products:
- Mailslot File System

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-105537

## CVE-2026-105549

CVE-2026-105549 describes an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Smart Card subsystem. An authorized attacker with physical access to the target device can leverage this flaw to disclose sensitive information, potentially bypassing security controls tied to smart card authentication or data storage.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-105549

CVE-2026-105557 is an information disclosure vulnerability in the Windows DHCP Server component. - Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL) for Node.js

Affected products:
- Windows Function Discovery Resource Publication

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-125134

## CVE-2026-88212

A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the Windows Network Address Translation (NAT) component, which could allow an unauthenticated attacker on an adjacent network to achieve remote code execution. Detection efforts should focus on anomalous traffic or memory patterns originating from the local network segment affecting the NAT service.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-88212

## CVE-2026-88222

The Microsoft WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL is susceptible to a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow a remote, unauthorized attacker to achieve remote code execution via a network-based attack vector.

## CVE-2026-118143

CVE-2026-118143 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Kernel. A local attacker with physical access to the target system can leverage this vulnerability to perform privilege escalation.

Affected products:
- Windows

## CVE-2026-119385

A race condition vulnerability exists in Windows Hyper-V due to improper synchronization of shared resources. This vulnerability allows an authorized local attacker to trigger a denial of service condition on the affected system.

Affected products:
- Hyper-V

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-119385






































































































































































































































































































Related in this roundup: [CVE-2026-95913](#cve-2026-95913), [CVE-2026-96965](#cve-2026-96965), [CVE-2026-113856](#cve-2026-113856).

## CVE-2026-119386

A use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Resilient File System (ReFS) driver allows a local, authenticated attacker to escalate privileges. The flaw resides in how ReFS manages memory, which can be exploited by an attacker with local access to achieve higher privilege execution on the system.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-119386

## CVE-2026-119393

A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the Windows Credential Manager, which can be exploited by an authorized local attacker to gain elevated privileges on the affected system.

Affected products:
- Windows Credential Manager

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-119393

## CVE-2026-119394

CVE-2026-119394 describes a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Enhanced Storage component. The flaw can be triggered by an authorized attacker to achieve remote code execution via a physical attack vector.

Affected products:
- Windows Enhanced Storage

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-119394

## CVE-2026-119395

An out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists within the Storport.sys driver on Windows systems. This vulnerability allows an authorized attacker with physical access to the target machine to perform unauthorized information disclosure.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-119395

CVE-2026-119821 is an elevation of privilege vulnerability in the Windows Network Connection Broker component. The flaw is caused by improper authorization, which allows a locally authenticated attacker to elevate their privileges to a higher level of access.

Affected products:
- Windows

- Windows

## CVE-2026-119830

The Windows Storport Miniport Driver is susceptible to a heap-based buffer overflow that could be leveraged by a local attacker with physical access to the system to escalate privileges.

## CVE-2026-119836

CVE-2026-119836 is a use-after-free vulnerability within Windows Management Services that enables an authorized local attacker to perform information disclosure. Detection efforts should focus on anomalous access patterns to management service memory spaces or unexpected service crashes.

Affected products:
- Windows Management Services

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-119836

## CVE-2026-119837

A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the Windows Universal Disk Format File System Driver (UDFS). An authorized local attacker can exploit this vulnerability to achieve privilege escalation on the affected system.

Affected products:
- Windows Universal Disk Format File System Driver

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-119837

## CVE-2026-119838

Affected products:
- Windows Installer

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-119838

Affected products:
- Windows Remote Access API

## CVE-2026-119855

CVE-2026-119855 is a buffer over-read vulnerability within the Windows COM+ Event System Service. The flaw allows an authorized local attacker to perform an information disclosure attack by reading memory outside of the intended buffer bounds.

Affected products:
- Windows COM+ Event System Service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-119855

## CVE-2026-119856

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-119856

- Windows

## CVE-2026-119900

Microsoft has disclosed an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows NTFS file system driver. This flaw allows a locally authenticated attacker to elevate their privileges on the host system. Detection engineering should focus on monitoring for unusual access patterns to low-level filesystem drivers or unexpected local privilege escalation attempts.

Affected products:
- Windows

- Windows

## CVE-2026-119961

CVE-2026-119961 describes a race condition vulnerability within the Windows Internet Information Services (IIS) component, resulting from improper synchronization during concurrent execution. This flaw enables an unauthorized remote attacker to achieve remote code execution (RCE) by leveraging the race condition over a network.

Affected products:
- Internet Information Services

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-119961

## CVE-2026-122297

CVE-2026-122297 is an information disclosure vulnerability in the Windows Kernel Transaction Manager caused by the use of an uninitialized resource. An authorized local attacker could potentially leverage this flaw to access sensitive memory information.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-122297

## CVE-2026-122474

A time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability exists in the Windows Security Account Manager (SAM) Remote Protocol, which can be leveraged by an unauthorized network attacker to bypass security feature protections. Detection engineers should monitor for anomalous network traffic targeting SAM interface functions or unexpected authentication flow patterns that may indicate attempts to exploit race conditions during security credential verification.

Affected products:
